tools.name: create_alert_rule
tools.description: Create a new custom alert rule for real-time portfolio monitoring (e.g. price threshold, P&L %, cash ratio). Requires user confirmation.

symbol.description: Asset symbol (e.g. "BTC", "AAPL") required for price and P&L metrics.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Create a new financial goal with a target amount. Requires explicit human confirmation before execution.

title.description: Title of the goal, e.g. Emergency Fund, Apartment Deposit

targetAmount.description: Target amount to achieve in EUR

deadline.description: Target deadline date in YYYY-MM-DD format

tools.name: export_gdpr_archive
tools.description: Download the GDPR access / portability archive (profile, consent, JSON backup and CSV files) of the current real account in the browser. Not available for the demo account. Requires explicit user confirmation. The archive content is never returned to the assistant.

tools.name: get_asset_allocation
tools.description: Get the asset allocation breakdown by asset class (Equity, Crypto, Cash, ETF, Real Estate) with values and percentages.

tools.name: get_cost_basis_method
tools.description: Read-only. Return the cost basis method of accounts: WAC (weighted average cost, French PRU) or FIFO (first in, first out lots).

accountId.description: Optional account id; all accounts when omitted

tools.name: get_email_verification_status
tools.description: Check whether the email address of the current GlassFolio account is verified (email/password accounts receive a verification code and link by email).

tools.name: get_gamification_status
tools.description: Retrieve user gamification profile: current level, total XP, investor rank title, level progress percentage, and unlocked achievements count.

tools.name: get_portfolio_summary
tools.description: Get an overall financial summary of the user portfolio (net wealth, cost basis, unrealized profit/loss, and position count).

currency.description: Base currency for calculation, e.g. EUR, USD. Defaults to EUR.

tools.name: get_privacy_status
tools.description: Get the legal and privacy status of GlassFolio: version and paths of the legal documents, the privacy contact, the current cookie / audience-measurement consent, and where to exercise GDPR rights (export and account deletion).

tools.name: get_progress_stats
tools.description: Retrieve the Stats shown in the Progress page: this week (transactions of the week, current tracking streak in weeks, XP earned this week) and all-time figures (total transactions, active weeks, current and best streak, total XP, level, achievements unlocked, goals reached, date tracking started). Read-only.

tools.name: get_security_status
tools.description: Inspect the current E2EE security posture of GlassFolio (vault lock state, encryption algorithm, 2FA/TOTP status, registered passkeys count, and recent security audit events with sanitized details).

includeAuditHistory.description: Whether to include the last 5 security audit events. Defaults to true.

tools.name: get_storage_status
tools.description: Report where GlassFolio keeps the data in local mode (the local server / Docker volume, or only this browser) and whether recent changes were saved. Read-only; never exposes data or error internals.

tools.name: get_tax_summary
tools.description: Calculate and return capital gains, tax estimates, and tax comparison (PFU flat tax vs barème progressif) for a given fiscal year in France.

fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year (e.g. "2024", "2025"). Defaults to previous year or current year.

tools.name: import_snapshot
tools.description: Import a holdings snapshot CSV into an account so its positions match the file exactly (non-fiscal adjustments, re-importing the same file changes nothing). Requires explicit human confirmation before execution. Use preview_snapshot_import first.

closeMissing.description: Close positions absent from the file (default true)

fileName.description: Original file name for the import history

tools.name: list_alert_rules
tools.description: List all custom user-defined alert rules (price threshold, P&L %, cash ratio) with their trigger history and enabled state.

tools.name: list_auth_methods
tools.description: List all configured authentication and recovery methods for the current account (password, passkeys, TOTP 2FA, OAuth providers, and recovery key). Enrollment or removal of passkeys/TOTP cannot be performed via AI tools as it strictly requires biometric/physical user presence and interactive step-up validation.

tools.name: list_goals
tools.description: List user financial goals, target amounts, current amounts, and completion percentages.

tools.name: list_instruments
tools.description: List the assets (instruments) known to the portfolio with their id, symbol, type (stock, etf, fund, crypto, cash, bond, other), ISIN and market identifiers. Use it to find the id before editing an asset.

searchQuery.description: Filter by symbol, name or ISIN

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.description: List all notifications and alerts with optional category filter (portfolio, fiscal, goals, security, system), read filter, and limit.

category.description: Optional category to filter notifications by.

unreadOnly.description: When true, only returns unread notifications. Defaults to false.

limit.description: Maximum number of notifications to return. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: list_positions
tools.description: List user asset holdings and positions with quantities, average cost (PRU), current price, market value, and unrealized gains.

type.description: Filter by asset class: All, Equity, Crypto, Cash, ETF, Other

searchQuery.description: Filter by ticker symbol or instrument name

tools.name: list_quests
tools.description: List active periodic gamification missions and progress towards completion.

tools.name: list_transactions
tools.description: List recent financial transactions with optional filtering by asset ticker or operation type (Buy, Sell, Deposit, Withdrawal).

symbol.description: Filter by asset ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL, BTC

limit.description: Maximum number of transactions to return (default 10)

tools.name: list_vault_secrets
tools.description: List all configured external API providers in the encrypted secrets vault (masked values only).

tools.name: lock_vault
tools.description: Immediately lock the encrypted vault, wiping all decrypted keys from memory. Requires explicit user confirmation.

tools.name: manage_notifications
tools.description: Perform management actions on notifications (mark single as read, mark all read, delete single, or clear all read). Requires user confirmation.

alertId.description: Notification ID required when action is mark_read or delete.

tools.name: preview_csv_import
tools.description: Read-only. Detect how a broker/bank CSV export would be imported: delimiter, header row, broker preset, date order and the proposed column mapping (history = transaction journal, snapshot = current holdings). Nothing is saved.

tools.name: preview_snapshot_import
tools.description: Read-only. Compare a holdings snapshot CSV with the current positions of an account and list what would change (new, increased, decreased, closed positions, average price updates). Nothing is saved.

csvText.description: Raw snapshot CSV (symbol or ISIN, quantity, average price)

closeMissing.description: Close positions absent from the file (default true)

tools.name: propose_csv_mapping
tools.description: Read-only. Propose which GlassFolio field each column of any broker/bank CSV should feed, from its header and its cells (works on unknown layouts and foreign languages). Every column is reported as matched, ambiguous (a weak or contested guess) or unmatched, with example values and alternatives, so the user only has to decide the doubtful ones. Nothing is saved.

tools.name: record_transaction
tools.description: Record a new financial transaction (Buy, Sell, Deposit, Withdrawal). Requires explicit human confirmation before execution.

instrument.description: Asset name, e.g. Apple Inc, Bitcoin

symbol.description: Asset ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL, BTC

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to current date)

account.description: Name of the account it belongs to (defaults to an account in that currency, else the first one)

tools.name: resend_verification_email
tools.description: Send a new verification email (security code + confirmation link) to the current account address. Only for unverified email/password accounts. Requires explicit user confirmation.

tools.name: rotate_encryption_key
tools.description: Initiate rotation of the Data Encryption Key (DEK) to re-encrypt all stored records with a fresh AES-256-GCM key. For client-side envelope encryption security, the master password cannot be accepted via AI tool arguments; this action directs the user to the interactive in-app step-up re-wrapping flow.

tools.name: set_cost_basis_method
tools.description: Change the cost basis method of an account (WAC = weighted average cost / PRU, FIFO = first in first out) and recompute its positions and realized P&L. Requires explicit human confirmation before execution.

tools.name: simulate_tax_impact
tools.description: Simulate French flat-tax (PFU: income tax + social contributions, at the rates of the fiscal year) impact for a hypothetical capital gain.

grossGain.description: Gross capital gain in EUR to simulate tax on

fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year whose rates apply, defaults to the current year

tools.name: suggest_next_milestone
tools.description: Analyzes incomplete or partially unlocked achievements and recommends the closest financial milestone within reach with actionable advice.

tools.name: update_instrument
tools.description: Edit the metadata of an asset (name, symbol, type, ISIN, exchange, network, contract address, currency), for example to move a token from stocks to crypto. Positions and tax figures are recomputed. Identify the asset with instrumentId (see list_instruments) or its current symbol. Requires explicit human confirmation before execution.

symbol.description: Current symbol of the asset, when the id is not known

exchange.description: Exchange or market (empty string clears it)

network.description: Blockchain network for crypto (empty string clears it)

contractAddress.description: Token contract address for crypto (empty string clears it)

mergeIntoId.description: Id of a duplicate asset to merge this one into (moves its transactions)
